references.text: Jesus also warns in Matthew about false messiahs and prophets who will perform great signs and wonders to deceive, which resembles the warning in Mark.
Luke contains a similar warning that many will come in Jesus' name and claim to be Him, and not follow them.
In Exodus, the people are warned against following other gods, which can be seen as a parallel to the warning against following false messiahs.
Revelation describes how false prophets will perform signs to deceive people, mirroring the warning in Mark.
